scope: First 300-K calibrated proposal on one three-atom condition; one training seed and finite-reference uncertainty.

training.scope:
Train a stochastic proposal by mean finite-path work, initialized from FM.

This is an existing path-space KL/SNF teacher objective. The eventual position
student remains a separately evaluated flow-matching model. Work is shifted by
a fixed source energy for logging; no normalizer is assumed known.

reference_comparison.scope:
Compare frozen work samples to an independent three-atom reference.

Finite-sample normalizers and self-normalized moments remain statistical
estimates. Empirical errors cannot detect a tail or basin missed by all draws.
limitations: No low-ESS delta error is presented as a confidence interval.
Reference errors use only four independent scrambles.
Matching a few moments or a normalizer does not prove full distributional accuracy.
One training seed is not replication.

xtb.scope:
Assess fixed work-sampler outputs with geometry diagnostics and independent xTB.

All geometries enter contact/diversity diagnostics. A seeded subset, selected
without energies or work weights, enters GFN2 single-point and relaxation checks.
Failures remain in every denominator. This is conditional method development,
not a certificate of chemical validity or equilibrium mode coverage.
limitations: Contact graphs are distance heuristics; fragments are allowed by the declared target.
Distance profiles are incomplete invariants, not aligned molecular RMSD or mode labels.
Importance ESS describes these weights, not proven mode coverage.
One training seed and one condition do not establish reproducible molecular benefit.
Strain statistics condition on convergence; report failures alongside them.

paired.ranking: converged before failed; then lower strain. This ranking is not chemical validity.
